course.title: Dalail al-Khayrat
course.subtitle: The classical salawat collection of Imam al-Jazuli, one hizb per day of the week, with transliteration and reverent recitation-style audio for every line
course.heroLedeSuffix: Learn Dalail al-Khayrat sentence by sentence, day by day, with transliteration and reverent tarteel-style audio for every line.

exercises.prompt: الْحِزْبُ الْأَوَّلُ لَيْلَةَ الِاثْنَيْنِ
options: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as the stars in the sky, for indeed You have counted them.

O Allah, I ask You for taking the best of what You know and leaving the evil of what You know, and I ask You for the guarantee of sustenance, and contentment with sufficiency, and a clear way out from every doubt, and success through what is right in every argument, and justice in anger and in contentment, and submission to whatever is decreed, and moderation in poverty and in wealth, and humility in word and deed, and truthfulness in seriousness and in jest.
The First Part, Monday Night
O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger.
exercises.translit: Al-hizb al-awwal laylat al-ithnayn

exercises.native: الْحِزْبُ الْأَوَّلُ لَيْلَةَ الِاثْنَيْنِ
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as he deserves.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad until nothing remains of blessing; and have mercy upon our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until nothing remains of mercy; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until nothing remains of blessing; and send peace upon our master Muhammad until nothing remains of peace.
O Allah, O Lord of our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, reward our master Muhammad, may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him, as he deserves.
The First Part, Monday Night

O Allah, send blessings, peace, and grace upon our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad the Prophet, and his wives the Mothers of the Believers, and his descendants and the People of his House, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
pairs.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim and the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ وَتَرَحَّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَرَحَّمْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
pairs.en: O Allah, have mercy upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You had mercy upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ وَتَحَنَّنْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَحَنَّنْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
pairs.en: O Allah, be gracious to our master Muhammad and to the family of our master Muhammad, just as You were gracious to our master Ibrahim and to the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا سَلَّمْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
pairs.en: O Allah, grant peace to our master Muhammad and to the family of our master Muhammad, just as You granted peace to our master Ibrahim and to the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
pairs.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed, had mercy, and blessed our master Ibrahim and the family of our master Ibrahim, in all the worlds. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ أُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad the Prophet, and his wives the Mothers of the Believers, and his descendants and the People of his House, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
pairs.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

lessons.title: The Quranic Command to Bless the Prophet
lessons.description: The Quranic Command to Bless the Prophet

exercises.prompt: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ.
options: O Allah, I ask You for firm adherence to his way, and I seek refuge in You from deviating from what he brought.
Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet.

O Allah, have mercy upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You had mercy upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the first, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the last, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the prophets, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the messengers, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad in the Highest Assembly until the Day of Judgment.
exercises.translit: Innallaha wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna 'alan-nabi.

exercises.native: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ.
options: Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet.
O Allah, send blessings, peace, and grace upon our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his wives and his descendants and upon all the prophets and messengers and the angels brought near and all of Allah's righteous servants, as many times as the sky has rained since You built it, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as the earth has grown since You spread it out.

O Allah, send blessings upon them as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and the extent of Your knowledge and Your signs.

exercises.prompt: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا.
options: O Allah, I ask You for taking the best of what You know and leaving the evil of what You know, and I ask You for the guarantee of sustenance, and contentment with sufficiency, and a clear way out from every doubt, and success through what is right in every argument, and justice in anger and in contentment, and submission to whatever is decreed, and moderation in poverty and in wealth, and humility in word and deed, and truthfulness in seriousness and in jest.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your prophet, and our master Ibrahim, Your intimate friend, and upon all Your prophets and Your chosen ones among the people of Your earth and Your heaven, as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and the utmost of Your knowledge, and the weight of all Your creations.
O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim and the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him with peace.
exercises.translit: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu sallu 'alayhi wa sallimu tasliman.

exercises.native: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as those who have sent blessings upon him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many times as those who have not sent blessings upon him, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad just as You commanded us to send blessings upon him, and send blessings upon him as You love blessings to be sent upon him.
O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him with peace.
O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the wasila, the excellence, the honor, and the great rank.
O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You commanded us to send blessings upon him.

exercises.prompt: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبِّي وَسَعْدَيْكَ، صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ الْبَرِّ الرَّحِيمِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ وَمَا سَبَّحَ لَكَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَسَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
options: O Allah, I have believed in our master Muhammad without having seen him, so do not deprive me in Paradise of seeing him, and grant me his companionship, and take my soul following his way, and give me to drink from his Pool a satisfying, pleasant, wholesome drink after which I will never thirst again. Indeed, You are able to do all things.

At Your service, O Allah my Lord, and at Your good pleasure! May the blessings of Allah the Good, the Merciful, and of the angels brought near, and the prophets, and the truthful, and the martyrs, and the righteous, and everything that glorifies You, O Lord of the worlds, be upon our master Muhammad, the servant of Allah, the seal of the prophets and master of the messengers, and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the first, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the last, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the prophets, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the messengers, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad in the Highest Assembly until the Day of Judgment.
O Allah, O Lord of our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, reward our master Muhammad, may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him, as he deserves.
exercises.translit: Labbayka Allahumma rabbi wa sa'dayk, salawatullahil-barrir-rahimi wal-mala'ikatil-muqarrabina wan-nabiyyina was-siddiqina wash-shuhada'i was-salihina wa ma sabbaha laka min shay'in ya rabbal-'alamin, 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin 'abdillahi khatamin-nabiyyina wa sayyidil-mursalin, wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

options: O Allah, I ask You for the good that our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, asked You for, and I seek refuge in You from the evil that our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, sought refuge in You from.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, and upon his family, his companions, his children, his wives, his descendants, the people of his house, his in-laws, his helpers, his followers, those who love him, and his nation, and upon us together with all of them, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

options: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

O Allah, send blessings, peace, and grace upon our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger.

exercises.translit: Allahumma barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid.

options: O Allah, send blessings, peace, and grace upon our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, and upon his family, his companions, his children, his wives, his descendants, the people of his house, his in-laws, his helpers, his followers, those who love him, and his nation, and upon us together with all of them, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

O Allah, I have believed in our master Muhammad without having seen him, so do not deprive me in Paradise of seeing him, and grant me his companionship, and take my soul following his way, and give me to drink from his Pool a satisfying, pleasant, wholesome drink after which I will never thirst again. O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad until nothing remains of blessing; and have mercy upon our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until nothing remains of mercy; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until nothing remains of blessing; and send peace upon our master Muhammad until nothing remains of peace.

options: O Allah, and just as I believed in our master Muhammad without having seen him, do not deprive me in Paradise of seeing him.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, and upon his family, his companions, his children, his wives, his descendants, the people of his house, his in-laws, his helpers, his followers, those who love him, and his nation, and upon us together with all of them, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي النَّبِيِّينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the first, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the last, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the prophets, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad among the messengers, and send blessings upon our master Muhammad in the Highest Assembly until the Day of Judgment.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالشَّرَفَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الْكَبِيرَةَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the wasila, the excellence, the honor, and the great rank.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي آمَنْتُ بِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ، فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِي فِي الْجِنَانِ رُؤْيَتَهُ، وَارْزُقْنِي صُحْبَتَهُ، وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَأَسْقِنِي مِنْ حَوْضِهِ مَشْرَبًا رَوِيًّا سَائِغًا هَنِيئًا لَا أَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
pairs.en: O Allah, I have believed in our master Muhammad without having seen him, so do not deprive me in Paradise of seeing him, and grant me his companionship, and take my soul following his way, and give me to drink from his Pool a satisfying, pleasant, wholesome drink after which I will never thirst again. Indeed, You are able to do all things.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ أَبْلِغْ رُوحَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِنِّي تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا.
pairs.en: O Allah, convey to the soul of our master Muhammad, from me, a greeting and peace.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا آمَنْتُ بِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ فَلَا تَحْرِمْنِي فِي الْجِنَانِ رُؤْيَتَهُ.
pairs.en: O Allah, and just as I believed in our master Muhammad without having seen him, do not deprive me in Paradise of seeing him.

exercises.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيُّكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَكَ مِنْهُ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيُّكَ وَرَسُولُكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
options: O Allah, have mercy upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, just as You had mercy upon our master Ibrahim and upon the family of our master Ibrahim. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, just as You blessed, had mercy, and blessed our master Ibrahim and the family of our master Ibrahim, in all the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good that our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, asked You for, and I seek refuge in You from the evil that our master Muhammad, Your prophet and Your messenger, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, sought refuge in You from.

And our master 'Isa, Your spirit and Your word, and upon all Your angels and Your messengers and Your prophets and the elect of Your creation and Your chosen ones and Your special ones and Your saints, among the people of Your earth and Your heaven.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَا نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ وَمَبْلَغَ عِلْمِكَ وَآيَاتِكَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon them as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and the extent of Your knowledge and Your signs.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَاةً تَفُوقُ وَتَفْضُلُ صَلَاةَ الْمُصَلِّينَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ أَجْمَعِينَ كَفَضْلِكَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send upon them blessings that surpass and exceed the blessings of all who send blessings upon them from all of creation, just as You are superior over all of Your creation.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٍ دَائِمَةً مُسْتَمِرَّةَ الدَّوَامِ عَلَى مَرِّ اللَّيَالِي وَالْأَيَّامِ، مُتَّصِلَةَ الدَّوَامِ لَا انْقِضَاءَ لَهَا وَلَا انْصِرَامَ عَلَى مَرِّ اللَّيَالِي وَالْأَيَّامِ، عَدَدَ كُلِّ وَابِلٍ وَطَلٍّ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send upon them blessings that are everlasting, continuous, enduring through the passing of nights and days, unceasing and unending through the passing of nights and days, as many as every downpour and every drizzle.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ وَسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَأَصْفِيَائِكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ أَرْضِكَ وَسَمَائِكَ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَا نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ وَمُنْتَهَى عِلْمِكَ وَزِنَةَ جَمِيعِ مَخْلُوقَاتِكَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your prophet, and our master Ibrahim, Your intimate friend, and upon all Your prophets and Your chosen ones among the people of Your earth and Your heaven, as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and the utmost of Your knowledge, and the weight of all Your creations.

pairs.native: حَفِظَ عَهْدَهُ وَذِمَّتَهُ وَنَصَرَ حِزْبَهُ وَدَعْوَتَهُ، وَكَثَّرَ تَابِعِيهِ وَفِرْقَتَهُ، وَوَفَّى جَمَاعَتَهُ، وَلَمْ يُخَالِفْ سَبِيلَهُ وَسُنَّتَهُ.
pairs.en: He kept his covenant and his trust, gave victory to his party and his call, increased his followers and his group, fulfilled his community, and did not deviate from his path and his way.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الِاسْتِمْسَاكَ بِسُنَّتِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الِانْحِرَافِ عَمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ.
pairs.en: O Allah, I ask You for firm adherence to his way, and I seek refuge in You from deviating from what he brought.

options: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the wasila, the excellence, the honor, and the great rank.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْأَخْذَ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا تَعْلَمُ وَتَرْكَ السَّيِّئِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ التَّكَفُّلَ بِالرِّزْقِ وَالزُّهْدَ فِي الْكَفَافِ، وَالْمَخْرَجَ بِالْبَيَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ شُبْهَةٍ، وَالْفَلَجَ بِالصَّوَابِ فِي كُلِّ حُجَّةٍ، وَالْعَدْلَ فِي الْغَضَبِ وَالرِّضَا، وَالتَّسْلِيمَ لِمَا يَجْرِي بِهِ الْقَضَاءُ، وَالِاقْتِصَادَ فِي الْفَقْرِ وَالْغِنَى، وَالتَّوَاضُعَ فِي الْقَوْلِ وَالْفِعْلِ، وَالصِّدْقَ فِي الْجِدِّ وَالْهَزْلِ.

Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet.

O Allah, I ask You for taking the best of what You know and leaving the evil of what You know, and I ask You for the guarantee of sustenance, and contentment with sufficiency, and a clear way out from every doubt, and success through what is right in every argument, and justice in anger and in contentment, and submission to whatever is decreed, and moderation in poverty and in wealth, and humility in word and deed, and truthfulness in seriousness and in jest.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْأَخْذَ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا تَعْلَمُ وَتَرْكَ السَّيِّئِ مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ التَّكَفُّلَ بِالرِّزْقِ وَالزُّهْدَ فِي الْكَفَافِ، وَالْمَخْرَجَ بِالْبَيَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ شُبْهَةٍ، وَالْفَلَجَ بِالصَّوَابِ فِي كُلِّ حُجَّةٍ، وَالْعَدْلَ فِي الْغَضَبِ وَالرِّضَا، وَالتَّسْلِيمَ لِمَا يَجْرِي بِهِ الْقَضَاءُ، وَالِاقْتِصَادَ فِي الْفَقْرِ وَالْغِنَى، وَالتَّوَاضُعَ فِي الْقَوْلِ وَالْفِعْلِ، وَالصِّدْقَ فِي الْجِدِّ وَالْهَزْلِ.
pairs.en: O Allah, I ask You for taking the best of what You know and leaving the evil of what You know, and I ask You for the guarantee of sustenance, and contentment with sufficiency, and a clear way out from every doubt, and success through what is right in every argument, and justice in anger and in contentment, and submission to whatever is decreed, and moderation in poverty and in wealth, and humility in word and deed, and truthfulness in seriousness and in jest.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ لِي ذُنُوبًا فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ وَذُنُوبًا فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَلْقِكَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, I have sins between me and You, and sins between me and Your creation.

options: O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of Miraculous Graces.
O Allah, send blessings upon him by sending blessings upon whom the old and the young are shown mercy.

O Allah, I ask You for the good that You know, and I seek refuge in You from the evil that You know, and I ask Your forgiveness for all that You know, for indeed You know and we do not know, and You are the Knower of the unseen.
O Allah, send blessings upon the Possessor of the Two Sandals.
exercises.translit: Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ma ta'lamu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma ta'lamu, wa astaghfiruka min kulli ma ta'lamu, innaka ta'lamu wa la na'lamu, wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي مِنْ زَمَانِ هَذَا، وَإِحْدَاقِ الْفِتَنِ، وَتَوَلِّي أَهْلِ الْجُرْأَةِ عَلَيَّ، وَاسْتِضْعَافِهِمْ إِيَّايَ.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad as many as those who sent blessings upon him, and as many as those who did not send blessings upon him, and as many times as blessings have been sent upon him, and multiples of that, as he deserves, and as You love and are pleased for him.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, as many as Your knowledge encompasses and Your Book has counted, and Your angels have witnessed, and be pleased with his companions, and have mercy on his nation. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
O Allah, have mercy on me in this age of mine, with trials surrounding me, and the bold ones turning against me, and their considering me weak.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family, the sea of Your lights, the mine of Your secrets, the tongue of Your proof, the bridegroom of Your kingdom, the imam of Your presence, and the seal of Your prophets — blessings that endure as You endure and remain as You remain, blessings that please You and please him and through which You are pleased with us, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
exercises.translit: Allahummar-hamni min zamani hadha, wa ihdaqil-fitani, wa tawalli ahlil-jur'ati 'alayya, wastidh'afihim iyyaya.

O Allah, send blessings upon him who strove earnestly with all seriousness.

O Allah, send blessings upon him to whom the lizard spoke in his gathering, among his learned companions.

pairs.en: And send blessings upon our master Muhammad, whose light is from the Light of Lights, and by the ray of whose secret all secrets were illuminated.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، وَمِنَ الذُّلِّ إِلَّا لَكَ، وَمِنَ الْخَوْفِ إِلَّا مِنْكَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, except poverty toward You, and from abasement, except before You, and from fear, except of You.

pairs.native: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَقُولَ زُورًا، أَوْ أَغْشَى فُجُورًا، أَوْ أَكُونَ بِكَ مَغْرُورًا.
pairs.en: And I seek refuge in You from saying falsehood, or committing indecency, or being deluded about You.

pairs.native: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ، وَذُلِّ الدَّيْنِ، وَخَيْبَةِ الرَّجَاءِ، وَزَوَالِ النِّعْمَةِ، وَفُجَاءَةِ النِّقْمَةِ.
pairs.en: And I seek refuge in You from the gloating of enemies, the humiliation of debt, disappointed hope, the departure of blessing, and the sudden onset of punishment.

lessons.description: The Wasila and the Pool of Intercession

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تَكُونُ لَكَ رِضًا وَلَهُ جَزَاءً وَلِحَقِّهِ أَدَاءً، وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ نَبِيًّا عَنْ قَوْمِهِ وَرَسُولًا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى جَمِيعِ إِخْوَانِهِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, filling this world and filling the next; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, filling this world and filling the next; and have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, filling this world and filling the next; and reward our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, filling this world and filling the next; and grant peace upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, filling this world and filling the next.
O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the wasila, bring him to what he hopes for, and make him the first to intercede and the first whose intercession is accepted.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Ha of Mercy, the Mim of Sovereignty, the Dal of Endurance, the complete master, the opener, the seal, as many as exists or has existed in Your knowledge, every time the rememberers remember him, and every time the heedless are heedless of remembering You and him — an enduring blessing lasting as You endure, remaining as You remain, with no end to it short of Your knowledge, for indeed You have power over all things. (recited three times)

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, a blessing that is pleasing to You, a reward for him, and a fulfillment of his due, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the Praised Station which You promised him, and reward him on our behalf with the best that You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his people or any messenger on behalf of his nation, and send blessings upon all his brethren among the prophets and the righteous, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
exercises.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin salatan takunu laka ridhan wa lahu jaza'an wa li-haqqihi ada'an, wa atihil-wasilata wal-fadhilata wal-maqamal-mahmudal-ladhi wa'adtahu, wajzihi 'anna afdhala ma jazayta nabiyyan 'an qawmihi wa rasulan 'an ummatihi, wa salli 'ala jami'i ikhwanihi minan-nabiyyina was-salihina, ya arhamar-rahimin.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon his family and companions, and grant abundant, good, blessed peace, plentiful, beautiful, enduring as long as the dominion of Allah endures.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and upon the family of our master Muhammad, who is the most radiant and dazzling of the suns of guidance, the most renowned of the prophets in glory, and whose light is the most manifest and purest of the lights of character, and the most noble and most just in creation.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تَكُونُ لَكَ رِضًا وَلَهُ جَزَاءً وَلِحَقِّهِ أَدَاءً، وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ نَبِيًّا عَنْ قَوْمِهِ وَرَسُولًا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى جَمِيعِ إِخْوَانِهِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, a blessing that is pleasing to You, a reward for him, and a fulfillment of his due, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the Praised Station which You promised him, and reward him on our behalf with the best that You have rewarded any prophet on behalf of his people or any messenger on behalf of his nation, and send blessings upon all his brethren among the prophets and the righteous, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فَضَائِلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَشَرَائِفَ زَكَوَاتِكَ وَنَوَامِيَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَعَوَاطِفَ رَأْفَتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَتَحِيَّتِكَ وَفَضَائِلَ آلَائِكَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، قَائِدِ الْخَيْرِ وَفَاتِحِ الْبِرِّ وَنَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ وَسَيِّدِ الْأُمَّةِ.
pairs.en: O Allah, place the excellences of Your blessings, the noblest of Your graces, the increase of Your benedictions, the tenderness of Your compassion and mercy and greeting, and the excellences of Your favors upon our master Muhammad, the master of the messengers and the messenger of the Lord of the worlds, the leader of goodness, the opener of piety, the Prophet of Mercy, and the master of the nation.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ ابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا تُزْلِفُ بِهِ قُرْبَهُ وَتُقِرُّ بِهِ عَيْنَهُ، يَغْبِطُهُ بِهِ الْأَوَّلُونَ وَالْآخِرُونَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, raise him to a Praised Station by which You draw him near and by which You delight his eye, one which the first and the last shall envy him for.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ آتِهِ الْفَضْلَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالشَّرَفَ وَالْوَسِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ وَالْمَنْزِلَةَ الشَّامِخَةَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, grant him grace and excellence, honor and the wasila, the elevated rank and the lofty station.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ آتِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَبَلِّغْهُ مَأْمُولَهُ وَاجْعَلْهُ أَوَّلَ شَافِعٍ وَأَوَّلَ مُشَفَّعٍ.
pairs.en: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the wasila, bring him to what he hopes for, and make him the first to intercede and the first whose intercession is accepted.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ عَظِّمْ بُرْهَانَهُ وَثَقِّلْ مِيزَانَهُ وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ وَارْفَعْ فِي أَهْلِ عِلِّيِّينَ دَرَجَتَهُ، وَفِي عَالَمِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ مَنْزِلَتَهُ.
pairs.en: O Allah, magnify his proof, weigh down his scale, make manifest his argument, and raise his rank among the people of 'Illiyyin, and his station among the world of those brought near.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا، وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَأَلِّفْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
pairs.en: O Allah, forgive me my sins, and my parents, and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small, and forgive all believing men and women and Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, and join us together with them in good things. My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful. And there is no power and no might except in Allah, the Most High, the Exalted.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نُورِ الْأَنْوَارِ وَسِرِّ الْأَسْرَارِ وَسَيِّدِ الْأَبْرَارِ وَزَيْنِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ، وَأَكْرَمِ مَنْ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ، عَدَدَ مَا نَزَلَ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى آخِرِهَا مِنْ قَطْرِ الْأَمْطَارِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا نَبَتَ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى آخِرِهَا مِنَ النَّبَاتِ وَالْأَشْجَارِ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, a blessing by which You honor his abode, ennoble his afterlife, and by which You bring him on the Day of Resurrection to his wish and his contentment. This blessing is in reverence for your right, O our master Muhammad. (recited three times)

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Light of Lights, the Secret of Secrets, the master of the righteous, the ornament of the excellent messengers, and the most noble of those over whom night has darkened and day has shone, as many as have fallen from the beginning of the world to its end of raindrops, and as many as have grown from the beginning of the world to its end of plants and trees, an enduring blessing lasting as long as the dominion of Allah, the One, the All-Subduing.
O Allah, send blessings upon Your chosen prophet, Your well-pleasing messenger, Your selected friend, and Your trustee over the revelation of heaven.
O Allah, grant him grace and excellence, honor and the wasila, the elevated rank and the lofty station.
exercises.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin nuril-anwari wa sirril-asrari wa sayyidil-abrari wa zaynil-mursalinal-akhyari, wa akrami man azlama 'alayhil-laylu wa ashraqa 'alayhin-nahar, 'adada ma nazala min awwalid-dunya ila akhiriha min qatril-amtar, wa 'adada ma nabata min awwalid-dunya ila akhiriha minan-nabati wal-ashjar, salatan da'imatan bidawami mulkillahil-wahidil-qahhar.

options: O Allah, place the excellences of Your blessings, the noblest of Your graces, the increase of Your benedictions, the tenderness of Your compassion and mercy and greeting, and the excellences of Your favors upon our master Muhammad, the master of the messengers and the messenger of the Lord of the worlds, the leader of goodness, the opener of piety, the Prophet of Mercy, and the master of the nation.

And I ask You, O Allah, by the names written on the brow of our master Israfil, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the brow of our master Jibril, peace be upon him, and upon the angels brought near.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Light of Lights, the Secret of Secrets, the master of the righteous, the ornament of the excellent messengers, and the most noble of those over whom night has darkened and day has shone, as many as have fallen from the beginning of the world to its end of raindrops, and as many as have grown from the beginning of the world to its end of plants and trees, an enduring blessing lasting as long as the dominion of Allah, the One, the All-Subduing.

O Allah, I ask You by Your Great right, and by the right of the light of Your noble Face, and by the right of Your Great Throne, and by what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your majesty, Your beauty, Your splendor, Your power, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden Names which none of Your creation has been shown.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Ha of Mercy, the Mim of Sovereignty, the Dal of Endurance, the complete master, the opener, the seal, as many as exists or has existed in Your knowledge, every time the rememberers remember him, and every time the heedless are heedless of remembering You and him — an enduring blessing lasting as You endure, remaining as You remain, with no end to it short of Your knowledge, for indeed You have power over all things. And I ask You, O Allah, by the names written around the Throne, and by the names written around the Chair, and I ask You, O Allah, by the Name written upon the olive leaf.

exercises.prompt: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي هُوَ أَبْهَى شُمُوسِ الْهُدَى نُورًا وَأَبْهَرُهَا، وَأَشْهَرُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ فَخْرًا وَأَشْهَرُهَا، وَنُورُهُ أَظْهَرُ أَنْوَارِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَأَطْهَرُهَا وَأَكْرَمُهَا خَلْقًا وَأَعْدَلُهَا.
options: O Allah, send blessings upon the Hashimite prophet, our master Muhammad, and upon his family and companions, and grant abundant peace.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him, together with his brethren the prophets.

O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and upon the family of our master Muhammad, who is the most radiant and dazzling of the suns of guidance, the most renowned of the prophets in glory, and whose light is the most manifest and purest of the lights of character, and the most noble and most just in creation.

exercises.prompt: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْعَرْشِ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْكُرْسِيِّ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالِاسْمِ الْمَكْتُوبِ عَلَى وَرَقِ الزَّيْتُونِ.
options: May Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad, the Prophet of Mercy and master of the nation, and upon our father, our master Adam, and our mother, our lady Hawwa, and whoever they bore among the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous, and send blessings upon all Your angels among the people of the heavens and the earths, and upon us together with them, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
And I ask You, O Allah, by the names written around the Throne, and by the names written around the Chair, and I ask You, O Allah, by the Name written upon the olive leaf.
O Allah, raise him to a Praised Station by which You draw him near and by which You delight his eye, one which the first and the last shall envy him for.

O Allah, forgive the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, and forgive us and our brethren who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts any rancor toward those who believe. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind, Merciful.
exercises.translit: Wa as'alukallahumma bil-asma'il-maktubati hawlal-'arshi wa bil-asma'il-maktubati hawlal-kursiyyi, wa as'alukallahumma bil-ismil-maktubi 'ala waraqiz-zaytun.

exercises.native: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْعَرْشِ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الْكُرْسِيِّ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالِاسْمِ الْمَكْتُوبِ عَلَى وَرَقِ الزَّيْتُونِ.
options: O Allah, I ask You by the Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted, and upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the mountains and they became anchored, and upon the seas and the valleys and they flowed, and upon the springs and they gushed forth, and upon the clouds and they rained.
O Allah, raise him to a Praised Station by which You draw him near and by which You delight his eye, one which the first and the last shall envy him for.
And I ask You, O Allah, by the names written around the Throne, and by the names written around the Chair, and I ask You, O Allah, by the Name written upon the olive leaf.

O Allah, forgive me my sins, and my parents, and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small, and forgive all believing men and women and Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, and join us together with them in good things. My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful. And there is no power and no might except in Allah, the Most High, the Exalted.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَقِّ نُورِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ وَبِحَقِّ عَرْشِكَ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِمَا حَمَلَ كُرْسِيُّكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَجَمَالِكَ وَبَهَائِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ أَسْمَائِكَ الْمَخْزُونَةِ الْمَكْنُونَةِ الَّتِي لَمْ يَطَّلِعْ عَلَيْهَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ.
pairs.en: O Allah, I ask You by Your Great right, and by the right of the light of Your noble Face, and by the right of Your Great Throne, and by what Your Chair bears of Your greatness, Your majesty, Your beauty, Your splendor, Your power, and Your dominion, and by the right of Your treasured, hidden Names which none of Your creation has been shown.

pairs.native: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ بِالِاسْمِ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ فَأَظْلَمَ، وَعَلَى النَّهَارِ فَاسْتَنَارَ، وَعَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ، وَعَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ، وَعَلَى الْجِبَالِ فَأَرْسَتْ، وَعَلَى الْبِحَارِ وَالْأَوْدِيَةِ فَجَرَتْ، وَعَلَى الْعُيُونِ فَنَبَعَتْ، وَعَلَى السَّحَابِ فَأَمْطَرَتْ.
pairs.en: O Allah, I ask You by the Name which You placed upon the night and it grew dark, and upon the day and it shone with light, and upon the heavens and they became lifted, and upon the earth and it became settled, and upon the mountains and they became anchored, and upon the seas and the valleys and they flowed, and upon the springs and they gushed forth, and upon the clouds and they rained.

pairs.native: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا إِسْرَافِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَعَلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ.
pairs.en: And I ask You, O Allah, by the names written on the brow of our master Israfil, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the brow of our master Jibril, peace be upon him, and upon the angels brought near.
